title: Garig-Ilgar language — Grokipedia
text: Garig-Ilgar, also known as Ilgar, is an extinct Australian Aboriginal language of the Iwaidjan family, formerly spoken on the mainland of the Cobourg Peninsula around Port Essington in Australia's Northern Territory. [1] It comprises two closely related dialects, Garig and Ilgar, which were traditionally associated with the drainages into Raffles Bay and the northern part of Bowen Strait ...
